Sent:       Wed 7/23/2014 4:44:51 PM
Subject:    Hamas song mocks Israeli MIA Oron Shaul




                                                                                     Bulletin
                                                                                July 23, 2014



          Hamas song mocks missing Israeli soldier Oron Shaul:
                    "We've taken a second [Gilad] Shalit,
                           a young, blond-haired boy
               Congratulations on this Ramadan victory.
                 This is the most beautiful holiday gift."
                   "Netanyahu... we blunted your Protective Edge"

          PA TV:
           "Joyous and cheerful crowds" in all Palestinian cities
                       "Great joy indeed... fireworks"
                    "Cries of joy over this achievement...
                of the Palestinian Resistance (i.e., Hamas)"

                             by Itamar Marcus and Nan Jacques Zilberdik




                                                                                                EFTA_R1_00464124
                                                                                                   EFTA01977567
   Hamas TV broadcast a song celebrating their claimed kidnapping of missing
 Israeli soldier Oron Shaul. Shaul has been MIA since his Armored Personnel
 Carrier was destroyed during combat in Gaza on July 17, 2014. In a mocking
   video, Hamas calls the "kidnapping" their "Ramadan victory" and "the most
beautiful holiday gift." The song also addresses Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu:
 "You retard, you will accept [our] terms and drink from the cup of humiliation."
The song opens with a fictitious phone call of someone trying to call the missing
                                      soldier:

                                    (Phone rings]
                                  (Israeli:) "Hello?"
                                   (Hamas:) "Yes."
                     (Israeli:) "Am I speaking to Shaul Oron?"
       (Hamas:) "What Shaul, my dear? You are talking to the Resistance. The
        number you dialed is temporarily kidnapped, thank you. Sincerely, the
                            Palestine Defense Forces."

                                SONG BEGINS:
                 "Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
           We've taken a second [Gilad] Shalit, a young, blond-haired boy
          Congratulations on this Ramadan victory. This is the most beautiful
                                     holiday gift.

                Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
           6092065 is poor Shaul's number - the Palestinians broadcast it.

                  Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
       Get out of here [Israelis] wherever you are, your face is changing colors
                             You lost Shaul Oron in Gaza

                  Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
                   Wait your turn, Shaul. There are others in line
                 We have taken your entire army prisoner. Be patient




                                                                          EFTA_R1_00464125
                                                                             EFTA01977568
                    Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
                   Netanyahu, before you go to sleep, go to the toilet
          Put a rubber sheet under the blanket and have the potty next to you

                  Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
       Netanyahu, your hair has turned white, and you still keep lying all the time
                  We've given the answer and confirmed the news

                 Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
           Netanyahu, we weren't afraid, we blunted your Protective Edge
       We kidnapped a second soldier - good news for the prisoners of freedom

                  Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
                 You think you're an octopus, Netanyahu, you retard
            You will accept [our] terms and drink from the cup of humiliation

                  Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
              We're not afraid of threats even if we all become Martyrs
        We've kidnapped a new soldier and soon 1,100 [prisoners will be freed]

                   Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
         Zionist, how wrong you are! My nation is free and won't be humiliated
            We have a general staff and an army of self-sacrificing fighters

                   Hurray! Hurray! The self-sacrificing fighters did it!
                   We've blown up tanks, Merkava [tanks] and jeeps
                                 We've flown drones

                  Hurray!…
